# Glocious Infotech

> Powering business communication. Driving digital growth.

Glocious Infotech is a B2B technology company that helps businesses communicate with customers, automate engagement, and accelerate growth through intelligent communication infrastructure, digital growth services, and technology solutions.

Glocious works across three connected capability areas. Business communication covers SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Voice, IVR, Email and API messaging delivered on reliable, scalable infrastructure. Digital growth covers SEO, SMO, SMM, PPC, content marketing, lead generation and lead management, positioned as measurable business growth programmes rather than standalone marketing services. Technology solutions cover website development, e-commerce, digital solutions and custom technology, including integrations into existing business systems.

Industries served include Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, E-commerce, BFSI, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Automotive, and IT & Technology.
